# Spectralmoon Studio

> AI-forward creative studio by Susana Barrero. Cinematic brand films, art-led websites, and living digital presentation cards. Tagline: Imagination is the technology.

## What the studio does

- Brand worlds: cinematic AI video production for brands (films, campaign visuals, product stories)
- Art-led websites: handmade, zero-framework sites where original art leads the design
- The Argonaut card: a living digital presentation card, original moving art with your name typeset inside, every icon a working door (https://argonaut-tech.netlify.app/)
- Brand identity: visual direction, palettes, typography, and motion built as one world

## How it works

- Every piece is an original, dreamed and directed at the studio: no templates, no stock
- Reference-driven AI generation with human art direction at every step
- Websites lead the offer; the Argonaut card is the signature add-on
